stem:
In the diagram a person who is 6 ft tall is standing on the ground 3 ft away from point P. A line segment drawn from the top corner of the building to point P creates two similar triangles.

Which proportion can be used to find h, the height of the building in feet?
visual_elements: Diagram with a person 6 ft tall standing 3 ft from point P, a building with height labeled h, horizontal distances 3 ft and 18 ft indicated, right angle shown at building base.
